description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification No. 983 - Order to amend the Notification No. 902 published in Gazette Ex. Ord. No. 1544/17 of 10.04.2008 - Excise Notification No. 984 - Order to rescind the Notifications No. 926 published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1680/24 of 19.11.2010 and No. 974 published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1901/19 of 13.02.2015
categorisation: This gazette notification amends excise license fees and security deposits under the Excise Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory amendment to existing legislation (specifically Notification No. 902), making it a legal/regulatory matter. While it mentions Minister Ravi Karunanayake, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail - it simply identifies him as the authority making the regulatory change under existing powers. The content primarily focuses on establishing new regulatory requirements rather than government personnel or structural changes.
